import re
import sys

variables = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*([a-p]|TMP|\d+)\s*;\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        variables[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else variables[source]

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {variables[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
